$comment: Single source of truth for the website's identity and outbound links.
Phase 3 (Astro scaffold) imports this rather than hardcoding anything, so
there is one place to fill in the domain and the socials when they exist.
A link with "url": null is a PLACEHOLDER and is not rendered. That is
deliberate: a half-filled config should produce a missing link, never a
dead one. Fill in the url and it appears; leave it null and it stays out.
See docs/WEBSITE_BLUEPRINT.md §13 for the open questions behind the nulls.
name: Isoperia
tagline: A settlement-builder RPG. Chop, mine, craft, build a village, and fight your way into the deep wilds.
shortDescription: A 3D open-world settlement-builder RPG that runs in your browser.

origin.$comment: canonical is null until the custom domain exists (blueprint D4/Phase 9). Until then current is canonical.

paths.$comment: gamePrefix must match --prefix in scripts/compose-site.cjs and GAME_PREFIX in scripts/deploy-report.sh.

contact.$comment: press is shown on /press. Use a role address, not a personal one, before this goes public.

newsletter.$comment: Blueprint Phase 10. provider is null until chosen (§13 Q2); the form is not rendered while it is null.

analytics.$comment: Blueprint §10 — cookieless only. null disables the snippet entirely.
